result.process_summary: Both the ping analogy and the concept of latency involve sending a unit of data from a source to a destination and measuring the duration of that transmission; latency is defined as the time taken for the data to travel along that path.
potential_breaks: Ping typically measures round‑trip time (there and back), whereas latency is often defined as one‑way travel time; the analogy conflates the two.
The size of the ping packet and processing time at the server can affect the measured time, which the analogy does not address.
